specification.independent_unit: Fresh residual-policy training repeat conditional on a fixed inherited parent; paired workloads and action replicates are crossed/nested evaluation measurements.

pilot_selection.rule: At least +0.25 DSR percentage points vs initial, descriptive paired 95% lower bound >0, no fixed-parent mean below -0.25 points, and nonnegative point contrast vs matching decomposition. Prefer short when both qualify but correct relative labels do not separate from short and shuffled.
pilot_selection.scope: Pilot development selection only; no confirmatory claim or formal-test access.

statistics: Fixed-parent-stratified crossed training-repeat/workload paired bootstrap, 4000 draws; four Bonferroni simultaneous 98.75% primary intervals. Primary DSR uses counts aggregated within each trained policy then equal policy/parent weighting. Action replicas and requests are not training repeats.
decision_boundary: NO_GO blocks formal execution. GO freezes method and all configurations before fresh formal training/test. Only an explicit separate --execute-formal invocation can run the full experiment.
